facts.fact: The Ministry of Gender, Youth and Social Development has initiated a process to upgrade the National Information System for Social Assistance (NISSA) and the Management Information System for Social Assistance (MISSA) while transitioning to digital payments.
The document says tablets and laptops will support the operations and management of the existing NISSA and MISSA systems used for the Child Grants Programme.
